directors.1: A director owes fiduciary duties to the company. Fiduciary means the director must act in good faith and put the company's interests ahead of their own.
directors.3: A director must not misapply company assets. Company property may be used only for the company's purposes as set out in this chapter.
directors.7: A director who has an interest in a proposed contract must disclose that interest to the board and must not vote on the resolution unless the articles expressly permit it after disclosure.
directors.9: Breach of duty may be met by an account of profits or by equitable compensation. This chapter does not list a criminal fine as a remedy for the civil breach.

constitution.2: The sample articles require three directors to be in office. A board of two is not a validly constituted board under this extract.
constitution.4: Subsection (3) lists the quorum. The quorum is two directors present and entitled to vote.
constitution.5: If that number is not present, the meeting stands adjourned to the same time on the next business day. No other business may be transacted.
